\ednentry{
  id = {EDN-19},
  title = {The DagsHub repository belongs to a team organisation},
  date = {2026-09-29},
  milestone = {M2: Reproducibility},
  topic = {Data Versioning, Experiment Tracking},
  participants = {@lukas2510, on behalf of the team; confirmation by the full team is pending until the laboratory session of 2026-10-13},
  decision = {The DVC remote and MLflow server is \texttt{recommenditos/\allowbreak{}MLOPS\_\allowbreak{}Recommenditos} on DagsHub, owned by a DagsHub organisation of the team and connected through the GitHub integration.
All five members have write access, granted per repository.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item An existing mirror under another account: it was the best in sync with GitHub, but its owner is not on the team.
\item A repository under one member's account: the project's data and experiment history would hang off one private account.
\item One mirror per member: the remote URL is committed in \texttt{.\allowbreak{}dvc/\allowbreak{}config}, so members would overwrite each other's setting.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} Cohort members outside the team have read access to our GitHub repository and can mirror it at any time.
The rule is therefore that the project's infrastructure lives where the team owns it.
An organisation costs one more form than a personal repository.},
  ai = {Information seeking, Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation},
  response = {Accepted with modifications},
  assessment = {AI found two existing mirrors, measured them against GitHub and recommended the better-synced one.
The measurements were right and the recommendation was wrong: AI never checked who owned the mirror.
Lukas asked, the owner turned out to be outside the team, and the decision taken on it was withdrawn the same day.
We accepted AI's second recommendation.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code session of 2026-09-29; the retraction followed Lukas's question about who owns the recommended mirror.},
  evidence = {\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/pull/26}{PR \#26}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/10}{issue \#10}, \texttt{.\allowbreak{}dvc/\allowbreak{}config}.},
}
